Doesn't Utah have a really complicated process to get your CC. There is one state where you have to jump through a shit ton of hoops just to get the damn thing.

Here in Indiana, fill out a few short forms online, get finger printed, talk to local police chief/sheriff, and wait 30-90 days. Some states you have to take a class, prove you worth with a couple hours of range time, etc. Almost everything besides a rectal exam.

Utah is simple. A class taught by a licensed instructor on the basics of gun safety and carry responsibilities, cost 50 bucks plus/minus ... fingerprints, a passport photo, and background check run from application info mailed into a State agency charged with maintaining the program.
